annotations.title: Set a per-issue agents-override for one role

description: Patch one role's harness/model/effort/prompt for a single mission, layered over ship.yml per-field (a role or field this call omits keeps resolving from ship.yml — SHIP-337). Use promptContent or promptPath(+promptRef) to run an ephemeral prompt experiment (spec D9) without committing to the target repo. Read-modify-write: this call is merged onto the previously stored override record (via get_agents_override), so a prior set for a DIFFERENT role — or a different field on this same role, e.g. an earlier harness pin — survives; the underlying PUT is a full-record replace and would otherwise silently drop it. This tool calls the SHIP API, documented at https://letsship.ai/docs/api.

baseBranch.description: Override the pipeline's fork/target branch for this mission

checkpoint.description: Pause the pipeline after this role's stage completes

effort.description: Reasoning effort for this role, mapped to the harness's own control at dispatch: low, medium, high or xhigh, and also max on claude-code. A value the harness does not take is refused at dispatch.

harness.description: The code harness this role runs on for this mission

issueId.description: The mission's issue id: a Linear key or a GitHub Issues id, e.g. SHIP-353 or WEB-42

model.description: The model id this role uses for this mission. The harness must support it

projectId.description: Project id the mission belongs to

promptContent.description: Inline prompt-experiment body, capped at 30,000 characters. Mutually exclusive with promptPath.

promptMode.description: How this prompt relates to the repo's own .ship/agents/<role>.md (or ship.yml-pointed) layer. replace (default) makes this the role's only role-prompt layer; extend resolves the repo's layer first and appends this content after it, as a separately attributed span. Only meaningful with promptContent or promptPath. NOTE: the merge is per FIELD, and prompt is one field — a later call that sets a new promptContent/promptPath without repeating promptMode replaces the whole stored prompt, reverting to replace.

promptPath.description: Repo-relative path to an L2 prompt file. Without promptRef this is the SHIP-347 pointer form (resolved at the pinned base branch); with promptRef it's a path+ref experiment resolved at that ref.

promptRef.description: Git ref for promptPath — only meaningful alongside promptPath.

rejectOn.description: Review rejection threshold — only meaningful on the reviewer role

role.description: The role this override entry patches

sandbox.description: Sandbox name or id this role starts in for this mission (beats ship.yml and the project default)

size.description: Container size for this role on this mission

name: set_agents_override
title: Set a per-issue agents-override for one role
